section_label: Example - Crystal Modification I from Acetone
notes: Charged as the starting material, 2 g. The patent states no mole amount and none is computed from the mass. No bond is formed or broken in this step: the same molecule is recovered as crystal modification I, so this record and the tembotrione crystal modification I product record in this section name one substance, not two. Tembotrione is known from WO 00/21924 and is treated as available rather than prepared here.

section_label: Example - Crystal Modification I from Acetone
notes: Same molecule as tembotrione: same atoms, same bonds, same formula C17H16ClF3O6S. It differs from tembotrione and from the other modifications only in the crystal lattice and is not a distinct chemical entity. It carries its own identifier because the patent names the modifications as separate things and the whole disclosure is about the differences between them. Crystal modification I, obtained here by dissolving 2 g of tembotrione in acetone at the boil and cooling slowly. It is the same substance as the tembotrione reactant record in this section. The patent reports no mass, no yield and no purity for it, so quantity, yield_pct and purity_pct are left null rather than inferred. physical_form is crystals because the text calls the isolated material the crystallisate; that functional reference is resolved to this record from the section heading and is not emitted as a separate compound. The dissolution temperature, the cooling rate and the drying temperature are conditions of the step and belong to pass A2. The canonical German aliases for this modification are not printed in this section's own lines, so aliases is empty here rather than carrying a spelling this section did not use; the section names it at line 659 only as "thermodynamisch stabilen Kristallmodifikation I". finalise.py unions aliases across sections, so the canonical spellings still assemble from the sections that do print them.
